What They Sell Instead
While they carry thousands of products across their division-specific
School Health Online Catalogs
, their inventory consists of:
Diagnostic Devices:
Equipment used on-demand by health professionals, such as the
Welch Allyn Spot Vital Signs Device
and no-touch forehead thermometers.
Emergency Preparedness:
Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs), specialized trauma kits, and epinephrine auto-injectors.
Sports Medicine Hardware:
Items for athletic trainers such as percussion therapy massagers (e.g., Therabody, Normatec), braces, and physical therapy equipment.

Special Education & Assistive Tech:
Augmentative communication devices (like TalkingBrix) and sensory therapy supplies.
